question: What was total revenue across all orders?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM order_items

question: What was total profit in 2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: Show monthly revenue in 2024 in chronological order.
sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which 5 countries generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much revenue and profit came from Japanese customers in 2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS profit FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE c.country='Japan' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: Compare profit by product category, highest first.
sql: SELECT p.product_category, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS profit FROM products p JOIN order_items i USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: How many orders used each payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Which customer segments bought the most Technology products by revenue?
sql: SELECT c.customer_segment, ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE p.product_category='Technology' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: List the top 5 products by revenue.
sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items i USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was the average order value, rounded to two decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_revenue),2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(total_sales) AS order_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: How many customers placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)>1)

question: Show daily active users (DAU) for January 2024.
sql: SELECT event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS dau FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND event_date < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Show monthly active users (MAU) in 2024.
sql: SELECT substr(event_date,1,7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS mau FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND event_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Compare monthly average DAU and MAU in 2024.
sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT substr(event_date,1,7) AS month,event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS dau FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND event_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2), monthly AS (SELECT substr(event_date,1,7) AS month,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS mau FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND event_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT daily.month,ROUND(AVG(daily.dau),2) AS avg_dau,monthly.mau FROM daily JOIN monthly USING(month) GROUP BY daily.month ORDER BY daily.month

question: How many distinct customers had a purchase event in 2024 by source?
sql: SELECT source, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM events WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND event_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: What was total shipping cost by country?
sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_cost),2) AS shipping_cost FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Compare total revenue for 2023 and 2024.
sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,4) AS year,ROUND(SUM(i.total_sales),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many distinct customers bought products in each category?
sql: SELECT p.product_category,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM products p JOIN order_items i USING(product_id) JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
